item.title: Lakers News: Deandre Ayton Named November Recipient Of Bob Lanier Community Assist Award
item.description: The NBA and NBPA announced that Los Angeles Lakers center Deandre Ayton has been named the recipient of the Bob Lanier Community Assist Award for the month of November.
